ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters representing less than 5% of the total surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary black ground across entire surface. High-contrast white circular spots concentrated on the distal left margin. Large, low-contrast circular gray mottling clusters (5-8 visible units) distributed across the medial and distal sections of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate angle of 45 degrees; depth is roughly 15% of the total vertical lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge displays high-amplitude irregular cavitations (missing tissue segments). Right lobe displays low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations along the continuous boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges follow an upward convex trajectory transitioning into a concave curve toward the medial notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-intensity white circular pixels (approx. 10-15 units) localized primarily on the left distal edge and scattered across the central fluke surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) detected on the mid-left lobe, oriented toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant tissue loss/amputation on the upper trailing edge of the left lobe, creating a jagged, non-linear indentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique concentric circular gray pigmentation 'halos' localized on the right lobe.
